steps.title: Record isolate information
steps.instruction: Document the isolate number(s) and lyophilized date(s) for each culture for your records.

steps.title: Decontaminate vial exterior
steps.instruction: Wipe the aluminum cover and outside of the vial with isopropyl alcohol.

steps.title: Open lyophilized vial aseptically
steps.instruction: Using sturdy forceps, remove the aluminum cover and rubber stopper; wipe the outside of the stopper and neck with isopropyl alcohol before removal.

steps.title: Resuspend Salmonella/E. coli cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL sterile reagent‑grade water to the lyophilized pellet, let stand a few minutes or mix gently to obtain a uniform suspension.

steps.title: Plate Salmonella/E. coli suspension
steps.instruction: Plate 10 µL of the suspension onto a blood agar plate (BAP) in duplicate and incubate at 37 °C overnight in aerobic conditions.

steps.title: Inoculate BHI broth
steps.instruction: Add the remaining suspension to 5 mL brain‑heart infusion (BHI) broth and incubate at 37 °C overnight in aerobic conditions.

steps.title: Check Salmonella/E. coli plates Day 2‑3
steps.instruction: Examine the BAPs; if the culture appears pure, pick an isolated colony, streak onto a fresh BAP, incubate 37 °C overnight aerobic, use this growth to make DNA templates, and transfer culture to fresh medium and incubate 37 °C overnight to retain a retest stock.

steps.title: Optional repeat plating if no growth
steps.instruction: If plates show no growth, take a loop from the BHI overnight culture (step 6), streak on a BAP, incubate 37 °C overnight, then check the next day and proceed as step 7.

steps.title: Fill sequencing sample sheet
steps.instruction: Complete the sequencing sample sheet according to Table 1: include the unchanged strain identifiers in Sample_ID (and Sample_Name where available), set Project to PR0506_2024_Proficiency_Testing_Exercise, and optionally place organism names in the Description field.

steps.title: Perform sequencing data QC
steps.instruction: Run quality control on the sequencing data using the laboratory’s normal workflow (GenomeTrakr and/or PulseNet SOPs), e.g., GalaxyTrakr MicroRunQC workflow.

steps.title: Transfer acceptable data
steps.instruction: After QC, transfer data that meet quality criteria according to GenomeTrakr guidelines via BaseSpace or a shared drive.

steps.title: Share run in BaseSpace
steps.instruction: In BaseSpace, click the Runs tab, select the run, go to the Summary tab, click Share, invite gnometrakr@fda.hhs.gov, add the collaborator, also share the associated Project, and Save Settings.

steps.title: Share project in BaseSpace
steps.instruction: In BaseSpace, click the Projects tab, select project PR0506_2024_Proficiency_Testing_Exercise, click Share Project, invite gnometrakr@fda.hhs.gov, add the collaborator, and Save Settings.

steps.title: Transfer files for FDA labs
steps.instruction: For labs inside the FDA network, copy the sequencing run folder to the Isilon storage drive.

steps.title: Notify GenomeTrakr of completion
steps.instruction: Email genometrakr@fda.hhs.gov with subject “2024 WGS Proficiency Testing_YourLabName”, attach the sequencing sample sheet, and include: a) Run name, b) Sequenced by, c) Results submitted by, d) MiSeq ID, e) Flow cell ID, and f) SOP protocol (PulseNet SOP or GenomeTrakr SOP).

steps.title: Resuspend Campylobacter cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL sterile phosphate‑buffered saline to the lyophilized Campylobacter pellet, mix gently to obtain a uniform suspension.

steps.title: Plate Campylobacter suspension
steps.instruction: Plate 100 µL of the suspension onto a non‑selective BHIRB plate in duplicate and incubate microaerobically at 42 °C for 48 h.

steps.title: Check Campylobacter plate purity
steps.instruction: Examine the BHIRB plate for purity, pick an isolated colony, and streak onto a fresh BHIRB plate.

steps.title: Incubate Campylobacter isolate
steps.instruction: Incubate the streaked BHIRB plate microaerobically at 42 °C overnight; use this growth to make DNA extracts, then transfer culture to fresh medium and incubate at 42 °C overnight for a retest stock.

steps.title: Extract DNA from isolates
steps.instruction: Perform DNA extraction using the laboratory’s normal workflow (e.g., Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit) as described in GenomeTrakr/PulseNet SOPs; treat each PT isolate as any routine isolate.

steps.title: Quantify extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify DNA using the laboratory’s normal workflow (e.g., Qubit Fluorometer) per GenomeTrakr/PulseNet SOPs.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare libraries with Illumina DNA Prep (M) Tagmentation Library Preparation for MiSeq (V.3) following GenomeTrakr/PulseNet SOPs; process PT isolates together with routine isolates to meet cartridge loading requirements and include reference control strains if the run is not full.

steps.title: Load sequencing run
steps.instruction: Load the sequencing run as any routine run following established loading requirements; include control reference strains when needed.

steps.title: Run sequencing instrument
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries on an Illumina MiSeq or NextSeq 1000/2000 running Windows 10 (MCS v4 or later) according to the laboratory’s normal workflow.
